versions.content: Support of UDS service 0x22 ReadDataByIdentifier Status: DRAFT Description: The Diagnostic Management shall support the ISO 14229-1 service 0x22 ReadDataByIdentifier. Rationale: Allow the external test equipment to read data such as measurement values, configuration, coding values or logistical data from the diagnostic server. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Reading data and values from the server. Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1
